sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Pop-Pop Kitties is a classic Match-3 Puzzle game where players are tasked with creating combinations of three or more matching kitties to clear the board and earn rewards. The game starts off with a straightforward approach, but as players progress, new obstacles and complexities are introduced, testing their strategic thinking and reflexes.

One of the standout features of Pop-Pop Kitties is its use of special power-up kitties that can be used to clear the board more efficiently. These special kitties come in various shapes and sizes and can be combined in different ways to achieve specific goals. For example, the Fire Kitty can be used to clear a row or column of kitties, while the Bomb Kitty can clear a large area of the board. With the right combination of special kitties, players can easily clear the board and earn rewards.

As players progress through the game, they will encounter various types of obstacles, including locked kitties that can only be cleared by creating a specific combination, and blocked kitties that require players to clear the surrounding area to access them. Players will also encounter special power-up tiles that offer rewards or bonuses for clearing specific areas of the board.

The game also features a variety of level types, each with its own unique challenges and objectives. From clearing the board of all kitties to achieving a specific score or earning a certain number of stars, each level presents a new and exciting challenge for players to overcome.
